description: ⚠️ Destructive: Request deletion of a secret (it is scheduled for deletion; cancel with ncloud_secret_cancel_deletion before it is removed). Set confirm=true to execute.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute the destructive operation

keyIsolation.description: Which Secret Manager host to call: 'global' (default) for secrets encrypted with a KMS global key (secretmanager.apigw.ntruss.com); 'regional' for secrets encrypted with a KMS region-isolated key (ocapi-kr.ncloud.com/secretmanager — the only option in the JPN region)

name: ncloud_secret_request_deletion
